extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and editors (people maintaining or consuming a biography of a living person)
extracted.subtask_description: Creating or editing a Wikipedia biography of a living person, with emphasis on sourcing, neutral tone, and site style conventions. Covers editorial maintenance notices that guide verification and formatting.

rubrics_metrics.name: BLP: add citations for verification
rubrics_metrics.description: "This section of a biography of a living person needs additional citations for verification. Please help by adding reliable sources."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Surrounding guidance on the page: "Contentious material about living persons that is unsourced or poorly sourced must be removed immediately from the article and its talk page, especially if potentially libelous." Also appears elsewhere as: "This section of a biography of a living person does not include any references or sources. Please help by adding reliable sources." (These templates instruct editors to supply reliable citations and warn that unsourced contentious material must be removed immediately.)

rubrics_metrics.name: BLP: removal of unsourced contentious material
rubrics_metrics.description: "Contentious material about living persons that is unsourced or poorly sourced must be removed immediately from the article and its talk page, especially if potentially libelous."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an explicit policy-level instruction appearing in the article's maintenance notices: unsourced or poorly sourced contentious material about living people should be removed without delay. The article repeats related maintenance tags asking editors to add reliable sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use British English
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hidden category/note indicates the article should use British English spelling and conventions consistently. (The page also includes: "All Wikipedia articles written in British English".)

rubrics_metrics.name: Use dmy dates
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hidden category/note directing that dates within the article follow the day-month-year format (e.g., 22 May 1981) per the site's localization/style settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Short description alignment with Wikidata
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hidden maintenance category indicating the article's short description should be checked for consistency with the corresponding Wikidata description; editors are expected to reconcile differences where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: BLP articles lacking sources (maintenance flag)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A hidden-category maintenance flag noting the article is a biography of a living person that lacks sufficient sourcing; signals editors to add reliable references and address verification issues.
